cc:Work.dc:title: Sapphic Sacrament Sacrilege
cc:Work.dc:description: A short story about magical sapphic kink, and repurposing Christian themes for instead describing the transcendent experience of doing an extreme trust exercise with your partner.

text.tspan: Sapphic
Sacrament
Sacrilege
or,
knife play
by Autumn Natalie Florence
https://flittermouse.art
@autumnflitter
Terra smiled when she felt the cold
knife’s edge touch her throat. She said “Do
it, do it.”
Luna pressed the knife into Terra’s skin
— but only a little. Luna’s warm breath
came close again. She gave a thoughtful
“Hmmmm…”
Terra squirmed against the ropes a little.
“Kill me.” She scrunched her face to wiggle
the blindfold. “Please?”
The knife’s point dragged gently, gently
across her cheek.
At last, Luna said “Why should I?”
Already Terra was pouting again.
“Because — because I need it. And because
you like it.”
Luna said “I do. I like seeing you all
needy too.”
Terra mewed. “We’ve done a bunch of
slow teasing plays lately, and I don’t think I
can take another one today. Please,
Mommy, please, just kill me quickly.”
The knife tickled the nape of Terra’s neck
— then vanished. Luna laughed at her
whimpers. Then silence. Then, “Alright,
alright, I’ll put you out of your misery
already. Poor baby.”
Cold sharp plunged into Terra’s breast,
hot wet poured down her belly and up her
neck. Agony seized her, took her whole
body and mind, tighter than her bonds,
hard-stopped the whole stream of
consciousness. She gasped, then tried to
gasp, but couldn’t.
The blindfold’s darkness was swallowed
by a deeper darkness.
And then Terra glowed, golden joy
literally shining around the knife in her
heart, blooming, spreading, tickling her
scalp and her toes. She cooed and sobbed
and laughed, the sweat on her face, her
whole face sparkling. The ropes fell slack
and slithered away. The knife shrank and
slipped out and tinkled on the floor. The
wound in her breast closed, blood slowed
to a trickle. Terra sighed her deepest
satisfaction. And the blindfold lifted. Terra
lay still. Then opened her eyes so she could
adore Luna’s face.
Luna was breathing hard, thrilled, at
once slaked and thirsty for more. Together
they wept and giggled, and the music of
their feelings resonated on the chapel
walls. ∎
